$comment: Reference payload for GET /workflows/palette. One entry per step kind: display metadata for the designer + a pointer to the config JSON-Schema $def (single source of truth in workflow-definition.schema.json). The endpoint MAY inline the resolved config schema instead of the ref.

kinds.label: Start
kinds.hint: Entry point. Optional event trigger instantiates the flow.

kinds.label: End
kinds.hint: Ends a path; terminate ends the whole instance.

kinds.label: Service action
kinds.hint: Emit a command event; optionally await its completion.

kinds.label: Human task
kinds.hint: Assign to a user/role; approval/review/edit. Waits for completion.

kinds.label: Wait for event
kinds.hint: Block until a correlated external event arrives.

kinds.label: Timer
kinds.hint: Wait a duration, until a date, or on a cron schedule.

kinds.label: Exclusive branch
kinds.hint: Take the first outgoing edge whose FEEL condition is true, else the default.

kinds.label: Parallel gateway
kinds.hint: Split runs all paths concurrently; join waits for all.

kinds.label: Sub-flow
kinds.hint: Invoke another published workflow as a child.
